title: Sable and the Drop
author: Xanthe Coldharbour
blurb: Kestrel Brightwater, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
